mainText: Good morning. Futures are higher: the Dow up about four tenths of a percent, the S and P up about three tenths of a percent, and the Nasdaq up about half a percent, rebounding after Friday's declines ahead of big tech earnings and Wednesday's Fed decision. The ten year Treasury yield is five point zero one percent, little changed. Premarket movers: S P R C is up sixty two percent, the top gainer, and R E N T is up twenty nine percent. On the downside, Petrobras is down about twenty four percent after the Lula runoff win, while E W Z is down twenty seven percent and Nu is down twenty five percent. Tesla is up about two percent on full self driving approval in Latvia.
